title: Facing the Giants
description: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.

title: Crazy in Alabama
description: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.

title: Mortal Thoughts
description: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

title: 7 Seconds
description: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting.

title: Hard Luck
description: A former criminal (Wesley Snipes) goes on the run with a stripper (Jacquelyn Quinones) after a drug deal goes bad.

title: The Art of War
description: Underground after being accused of murdering a Chinese ambassador, a security expert (Wesley Snipes) comes out of hiding when terrorists threaten the United Nations.

title: The Replacement Killers
description: An Asian crime czar pursues a forger (Mira Sorvino) and a hired gun (Chow Yun-Fat) who failed to kill a policeman's (Michael Rooker) boy.

title: Half Past Dead
description: An undercover FBI agent (Steven Seagal) battles a criminal mastermind (Morris Chestnut) and his team of mercenaries after they break into the new high-tech prison on Alcatraz.

title: Sahara
description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole.

title: Fugitive Nights: Danger in the Desert
description: A Palm Springs private eye (Teri Garr) wants two policemen (Sam Elliott, Thomas Haden Church) to help her catch a fugitive.

title: Finding Graceland
description: A man (Johnathon Schaech) meets a Marilyn Monroe impersonator (Bridget Fonda) while traveling with an aging hitchhiker (Harvey Keitel) who thinks he is Elvis.

title: Hero
description: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.

title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
description: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).

title: A Fine Mess
description: Two small-timers (Ted Danson, Howie Mandel) win a fixed horse race, buy an antique piano and run from gangsters.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: Lake Placid 2
description: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

description: A police officer, the self-proclaimed watchdog of his neighborhood, becomes increasingly hostile toward the interracial couple next door.

description: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

description: A factory worker (Colin Farrell) becomes a hunted man after a procedure goes awry that would convert his dreams of life as a spy into real memories.

title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
description: An agnostic lawyer defends a Roman Catholic priest accused of negligent homicide during the exorcism of a college student.

title: All the King's Men
description: A Southern politician's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana.

description: In 1980s Detroit, Rick Wershe Jr. agrees to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself.
